results.name: Constellation Image Gallery
results.description: Interactive image gallery for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui) where photos float like stars and their tags form constellations. It is built for exploring by theme: the lines show how photos relate, so visitors follow a thread from one picture to the next instead of scanning a flat grid. Hover or focus a photo and lines connect every photo sharing a tag (a minimum spanning tree, so it reads like a star chart) while the rest dim; click to gather the constellation into a ring around the enlarged photo, Esc scatters it back. Seeded layout, slow idle drift, optional autoplay, light and dark themes, reduced-motion fallback, no dependencies. Use it for portfolios, mood boards and tag-based photo collections.
